quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and dangers. This sign tells drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park your car here at any time of day or night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and dangers. This sign tells drivers that traffic is coming from both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians near the road. This sign warns you about a school crossing or school zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and dangers. This sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and dangers. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: You cannot turn on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a road with three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: This sign stops drivers from:

options.text: Entering one-way streets and ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way only. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fines are doubled in work zones.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. These areas are dangerous for both drivers and workers. This sign tells you that breaking traffic laws costs twice as much in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Farm machinery may be on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Farm machinery may be on the road.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and dangers. This sign tells drivers to watch for farm equipment on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns you about low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign tells you a fire station is nearby. Watch for emergency vehicles on the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used for no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns you about a traffic signal coming up. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is coming from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. You must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means drivers from both directions can use the shared center lane only to turn left. Do not use the center lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter this road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a new lane is being added ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is prohibited. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey them. This sign prohibits passing other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about construction zones ahead. Be careful around construction. This sign tells you the right lane will be closed due to construction work.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you are following a driver using this signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must do. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must do. This sign tells you that from this lane, you can turn left or go straight at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you to be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead. Watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a sharp right turn coming up on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area. Watch for them and be ready to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be entering the road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrows point. In this case, the road curves to the left. You may see several of these signs placed along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead. Follow the directions the flagger gives you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand point upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points upward, it means they plan to turn right. Watch for this signal and adjust your driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are coming to two-way traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. All traffic in that lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead shows red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead shows green.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign controls how you park. You can park in this spot, but only for two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow the detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if possible.
Follow the detour to the right only if it is convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black lettering. Detour signs tell drivers to take an alternate route around a blocked roadway.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing where the tracks cross at a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may drag on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to prepare to stop at a stop sign ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs enforce traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign is posted near intersections to remind drivers not to block them.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only flows in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only flows in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows the only direction traffic can travel on this street.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for drivers with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for drivers with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved for drivers with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to avoid traffic congestion.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic merge.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make room for entering vehicles. Move to another lane if no one is next to you.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A community group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road ahead in a work zone.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road ahead in a work zone.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a curve is coming in the road.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you the road will curve to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic pass before you enter.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at traffic signals where you cannot turn right when the light is red. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: Should keep your speed until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Should not slow down because traffic will back up.
May slow down if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin reducing your speed now. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic.
Keep your speed limited for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The maximum speed is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed allowed on that road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you not to enter this road. It is often posted at the end of one-way streets. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what should you do?

options.text: You can continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the freeway. You have two choices: change lanes to continue through the interchange, or exit the freeway.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic signals arranged vertically always have red on top and green on the bottom. When arranged horizontally, red is always on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Come to a complete stop and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait for the intersection to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to wait to turn left until the left turn signal shows it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the beginning of one-way streets and ramps. It means you must not drive in that direction.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Be alert for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that highway section. You may need to drive slower than the limit in poor weather or road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A regulatory sign showing a red circle with a red slash means the action is prohibited. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people entering or crossing the roadway. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic and show rules drivers must follow. This sign tells drivers they can turn right or go straight from this lane at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and yield the right-of-way at an intersection. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs warn drivers to slow down at intersections and be ready to stop. Yield to other drivers and pedestrians. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show laws drivers must obey. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange signs warn drivers of construction zones. This sign means a work crew is on or near the road. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: People are walking on the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Slow down and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn you of upcoming hazards. This sign alerts you that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp left turn is ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Follow the detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the traffic pattern or route has changed due to road work. Follow the detour shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells you what you must do. Drivers in the left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drive if you drink alcohol.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield on green when turning left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells you what you must do. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for workers on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for workers on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of workers on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign shown in yellow with black markings. It warns that the shoulder is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means "Yield." Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and vehicles from other directions go first. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a narrow bridge is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign marks reserved parking spaces for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way and may have a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and diamond-shaped. This sign warns you that the road is slippery when wet. Be careful because your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows the lowest legal speed. Do not drive slower than this speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a railroad crossing ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It tells you that buggies may be ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic are coming together into one. Get ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road you are on crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road you are on crosses a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means you cannot do that action. This sign means no right turns are allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a complete stop and go when safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and go when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. It tells you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What do these signs mean?
questions.explanation: These are warning signs. They are yellow with black markings. They warn you about objects or areas that may be dangerous. Avoid them and slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a divider between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols. They alert drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful near roadwork areas. This sign tells drivers to follow a detour around construction work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Divided highway starts. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. You should slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride near traffic here.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
